decisions.ruling: Fans and lights are must - never shed.
No dimming of fans and lights at all.
Use the four load classes from the idea book.
Never cut a household off; restrict luxury instead.
The AC is on/off plus an ADVISORY setpoint, never automated.
No time-of-day tariff exists; a surcharge must be labelled a proposal.
The model is never presented as deployable.
Target homes first: no solar, no inverter.
No PZEM in this build: measured_w is null, never a simulated value.

note: Decisions override earlier drafts of these same documents. A forbidden phrase is excused when the line is stating the rule rather than instructing someone to break it.
